semantics.oof: Row-wise ten-fold OOF predictions with validation-fold early stopping. Pooled OOF scores are not the reported validation fold means.
semantics.test: Metrics of the averaged fold-model predictions on the fixed compound-disjoint test set, which was previously inspected.
semantics.fold_mean: Arithmetic mean of ten separately computed fold scores. Train uses the nine fitting folds and Valid uses the held-out fold of each model.
semantics.predictions: Development rows have held-out OOF predictions and direct ten-fold inference predictions; only the former represent held-out predictions. Test rows have direct ten-fold inference predictions and no OOF assignment.
